title: I'm hosting an IRL AI Game Dev meetup in Toronto! Comment or DM for Luma link
author: MunchyCerealGuy
selftext:
basically what the title says. I've hosted a bunch of AI agent meetups while the field was young back in 2024 and it was so fun to be around other enthusiasts when we're normally working alone or terminally online on Github, Reddit and Discord.

I feel like this sub is really writing the future of AI game dev with each new experiment and y’all represent the next era of game developers. I wanted to bring some of that energy to real life for those of you based in Toronto (Canada).

This is a meetup for AI game devs who are actively using AI tools and agentic workflows to build games. It will be a cross between a meetup and a demo event (food and drink will be provided). The event can provide a stage to present your game, share your experiences building agents for game dev/design, or share the role(s) agents play in what you're building.

If you're looking to advance the game development and design abilities of agents beyond what's currently on the market, this will be a place to learn a new tool, connect with others who have similar skills, and possibly create new opportunities.

Please comment below so I can share the link to register or you can DM me directly

Looking forward to it!!
